glosses: unchristian, unholy, ungodly (contrary to Christian teaching)
unusual or unacceptable; (especially of time) very early or very late

examples.text: Ach, du bist es! Ich dachte schon, wer zu dieser unchristlichen Zeit noch anruft.
examples.translation: Oh, it's you! I already wondered who'd call at this ungodly hour.
examples.english: Oh, it's you! I already wondered who'd call at this ungodly hour.

glosses: nicht dem christlichen Glauben entsprechend, entgegen der christlichen Nächstenliebe

translations.source_sense_description: nicht dem christlichen Glauben entsprechend, entgegen der christlichen Nächstenliebe

glosses: Not in accord with Christian principles; without Christian spirit; unbefitting a Christian.

examples.text: I hope I may never again be in a state of mind so unchristian as the mental frame in which I lived for some weeks, respecting the memory of Master B. [His bell rang] two nights out of three, until I conceived the happy idea of twisting Master B.‘s neck […]

Arius […] eventually died obscurely, reputedly as the result of an acute attack of dysentery in a latrine in Constantinople, which circumstance afforded his enemies some unchristian pleasure, and was eventually commemorated with exemplary lack of charity in the Orthodox liturgy.
